//: Post-deploy smoke checks (Slice 109). Health checks only prove a process answers for itself; these exercise paths that cross a process or container boundary, which is where every defect in the container cutover actually lived. A failing check fails the deploy and triggers rollback.

checks.name: enrollment-delegates-to-login-authority
checks.//: The exact request that broke after the cutover. Enrollment delegates /login to the login authority over the literal 127.0.0.1 (ADR 0005). When that target is unreachable the app returns 502 upstream_unavailable, which a client reports as a malformed response. Deliberately invalid credentials must produce an authentication verdict (401), never a gateway error.

checks.name: enrollment-healthz
checks.//: Kept as the control: it passed throughout the login outage, which is precisely why it is not sufficient on its own.
